towns.name: Eastwatch
towns.summary: Eastwatch (90.3N 43.1W) is the Viamontian knights' garrison on the eastern shore of the Isle of Ruin, the easternmost and most dangerous of the Halaetan Isles, an outpost of Sanamar reached by portals near Sanamar and west of Ayan Baqur. Its Town Network sign tells of the ancient ruins that gave the isle its name and of knights who hesitate to enter the frozen Shattered Out-Lands to the north; acpedia adds that many citizens hand out hunter kill tasks and that beer-making ingredients are sold here. In the world data it is a tiny outpost of five stone buildings on a flat ice-and-clay mesa at z 170 whose east and north sides fall sheer about 170 m to the sea (deep water from x 14300): two identical four-storey Grand Master Scrivener towers with tapered gold-trimmed roofs (top z 196.35), the east one standing right on the cliff edge; a two-storey tapered-roof barracks (Claire Artmad's hunting task upstairs); a stone trading hall with a smoking chimney; and a shop house (Archmage, Blacksmith, Healer, Shopkeeper). Five marble lanterns burn with blue flames, and the small west plaza holds the Life Stone, the swirling purple Portal to Town Network and the Destroyed Portal to Sanamar. A moarsman fort lies on the beach below. 1.8 km north-west, past the razorback ridge in a glacier valley of the Shattered Outlands, three red portals lead into the Egg Orchard (its own sub-site below).

shots.notes: Establishing + water: the camera starts SW over the island (ground 139) looking NE across the outpost to the open sea horizon, and swings ccw to SSE where it hangs 198 m above the sea and frozen shore, the town perched on its 170 m ice cliff. WBT get-height every 1 s: AGL 58.8-198 m; camera z 198 = 1.65 m above the tower tips (196.35) but never closer than 50 m horizontally to any structure; vmax 8.1 m/s.

towns.name: Egg Orchard Portal (Eastwatch sub-site)
towns.summary: The outdoor gateway to the Egg Orchard, part of the Eastwatch chapter: three red portal swirls side by side (West, the original Mid, and East mirrors) on the flat floor (z 100) of a glacier valley in the Shattered Outlands, 1.82 km north-west of Eastwatch past the razorback ridge (acpedia route: run west from Eastwatch to the pass at 93N 47W, then round the north mountain to 96.2N 48.1W). Blue-ice and clay walls rise 100-240 m on both sides. Around the portals stand alien Olthoi props: two 7.8 m spikes, giant orange-eyed mushrooms (6.4 m) and a mushroom tree (7.4 m) that erupts grey ash, glowing blue-green mucor, an abyssal-totem shard and an ore deposit, all on a low rock shelf. A Viamontian camp of lords and inquisitors (blue crystals 0x020010A7) lies 70 m north. Place this shot right before the Egg Orchard dungeon site.

towns.name: Egg Orchard
towns.summary: The Egg Orchard is a Throne of Destiny dungeon (level 140+, ACmaps 002B) entered from the three red portals in the Shattered Outlands near Eastwatch; it exists as three mirrors (Mid 0x002B, East 0x0064, West 0x00C8) and is the hunting ground of the Olthoi Ripper hunter quest, where Tanada Nanjou Shou-jen ninjas spawn in pairs after Rippers die. The Mid copy (LB 0x002B) has 639 EnvCells on 12 levels from +6 down to -60 m. You arrive in a two-storey 30 x 30 x 12 m hall with blue-green glass jellyfish lamps. Winding cave tunnels lead down from there: 5.3 m wide and 3.75 m high with bevelled walls, 45-degree bends and T-junctions. Wall vents along them spill heavy green gas under green lights. The bottom level (-60) is the orchard itself, a ring of four 20 m chambers (west, north, south and an egg-less east junction) joined by short tunnels. Twenty-eight enchanted olthoi eggs sit on the floors in a green ghost-haze that fills every chamber. In the west chamber stands a toxic hive pod (5.6 x 5.4 x 2.3 m) wrapped in green fog and a throbbing 8.7 m green halo.

shots.standingOrder: Thread the toxic-vent tunnels of the lowest level at speed, banking through every bend, then burst into the egg chamber; keep 1 m from walls and vent spouts; green gas may be faded.
shots.notes: HERO. Floor Z -60 (bottom level), 16 cells, 75.5 m: corridor south -> right-angle west past a green gas vent -> 45-degree bend SW -> T-junction south -> bend west -> across the north edge of the south egg room (eggs 3-4 m to the left) -> right-angle north through its doorway vestibule -> right-angle west past a second vent -> bend NW -> straight north between two staggered vents -> into the west egg chamber (hive glowing 10 m to the left, eggs right). Verified offline with the page's own planIndoorPath + fpv-corridor build on a graph rebuilt from the EnvCell/Environment DAT records: peak 5.9 m/s, min 2.2 m/s, no overspeed, bank up to 32 deg, camera 1.4-3.2 m above the floor; wall clearance min 1.01 m (45-degree bends), median 1.8 m; vent clearance 1.0-1.35 m at camera height (top flares 1.8 m); eggs 1.8 m+; hive never closer than 7 m.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly in on the glowing toxic hive at the heart of the egg chamber over the cluster of olthoi eggs; stay 1.5 m from the hive and the eggs; green fog may be faded.
shots.notes: Effect shot: the toxic hive (0x02000F97, 5.6 x 5.4 x 2.3 m, green fog + throbbing 8.7 m green halo) in cell 0x002B0106 with three enchanted olthoi eggs (0x02000AE1) just in front, in green ghost-haze (0x02000693). Camera 10.7 m -> 4.9 m from the hive centre (1.75 m from its edge at the end), z -56.1 -> -57.1 (3-4 m above the floor of the 12 m tall chamber), starting in cell 0x002B010C.

towns.verification: WBT on lbX 0 lbY 43: get-dungeon-info (639 cells, single connected component, 12 Z bands +6..-60), describe-floor and render-dungeon for all 12 floors (PNGs in research/egg-orchard/floor0-11.png). Then chorizite-parse-dat-record for all 639 EnvCells (client_cell_1.dat) and their 50 Environment records (client_portal.dat), which gave cell orientations, mesh boxes and portal polygons. From these I rebuilt the client's indoor graph: pos = rotated bbox centre at the floor; doors = portal polygon centroid, normal, height and bottom. I ran the page's own planIndoorPath and the real fpv.fpv-corridor build on that graph in node. Route 0x002B0134 -> 0x002B010C: 16 cells, all on z -60, 75.5 m, six right-angle heading changes (S->W, W->S, S->W, W->N, N->W, W->N; three of them through 45-degree bend pieces). Alternatives: the north way round the ring costs 1.165x and the south-arm detour more, so the router/camera choice is robust; the 0x132/0x131 starts were rejected because their alternatives were only 1.01x/1.07x. Flown at 13 s: no overspeed, 2.2-5.9 m/s, bank up to 32 deg, 1.4-3.2 m above the floor. Wall clearance (point-triangle vs all non-portal polygons of the route cells and neighbours): min 1.01 m in the 3.8 m wide 45-degree bends, p10 1.1 m, median 1.8 m. Vent cylinders and lips 1.0-1.35 m, top flares 1.8 m, eggs 1.8 m+, hive 7 m+. A small dip to 1.4 m above the floor at the 0x116 doorway vestibule (sloped portal). Hive push-in: dry-built with the registry; 2.9 m+ from all walls, floor and ceiling of cells 0x102-0x13D; 2.1 m+ from the eggs, 1.75 m from the hive's bounding box at the end. Object identities and sizes come from get-object-detail and the particle-fx-catalog (hive 0x02000F97, ghost-haze 0x02000693, vents 0x0200028D with 0x320001AB gas) and Setup/GfxObj parses of the vent mesh.
